in_sanskrit.name: देवदत्त

in_marathi.name: Devadutta
in_marathi.long_meaning: Devadutta हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Devadutta is a Sanskrit name derived from the words 'deva' meaning 'god' and 'dutta' meaning 'gift'. It is believed to be a name given to a child who is considered a divine gift or a blessing from the gods.
